title: Behavior Uncloning: Distilling Mode Redirection into Policy Weights without Inference-Time Steering
abstract: arXiv:2606.29201v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Behavior-cloned policies often learn multiple behavior modes from demonstration datasets, including modes that are unsafe or otherwise undesired at deployment. For example, a policy trained on diverse handover demonstrations may learn to pass a knife blade-first. Standard remedies such as data curation and inference-time steering either require access to the original demonstrations for full retraining or add substantial inference-time overhead. To address this gap, we propose MoRE(Mode Redirection), which redirects policy rollouts toward desired behavior modes through a short "uncloning" step. Specifically, MoRE distills the redirection signal from a temporary mode classifier into the policy weights to steer behavior. A retain loss balances this edit by preserving desired-mode competence, allowing the standalone policy to suppress unwanted modes with zero inference-time overhead. translated_title: 行为反克隆：将模式重定向蒸馏到策略权重中而无需推理时引导
translated_abstract: 行为克隆策略通常会从演示数据集中学习到多种行为模式，其中包括在部署时不安全或不符合预期的模式。例如，在多样化的物品交接演示上训练的策略可能学会以刀刃朝前的方式递刀。标准解决方案（如数据筛选和推理时引导）要么需要访问原始演示数据进行完整的重新训练，要么会带来大量的推理时开销。为解决这一空白，我们提出了MoRE（Mode Redirection，模式重定向），通过一个简短的“反克隆”步骤将策略的推演重定向到期望的行为模式。具体而言，MoRE将来自临时模式分类器的重定向信号蒸馏到策略权重中，以引导策略行为。一个保留损失通过维持期望模式的能力来平衡这种编辑，使独立运行的策略能够抑制不需要的模式，且推理时开销为零。在八个仿真与真实世界任务中，MoRE……
tldr: 提出MoRE方法，通过将临时模式分类器的重定向信号蒸馏进策略权重，使行为克隆策略能够以零推理时开销抑制不需要的行为模式并重定向到期望模式。
en_tdlr: MoRE distills redirection signals from a temporary mode classifier into policy weights, enabling behavior-cloned policies to suppress undesired behavior modes with zero inference-time overhead.
